description: This file contains test cases for sender label resolution functions: 'resolveSenderLabel' and 'listSenderLabelCandidates'. It uses the Vitest testing framework and imports functions from './sender-label.js'.

methods.name: resolveSenderLabel
methods.description: Resolves and formats a sender label based on available sender attributes such as name, e164, and id.

methods.name: listSenderLabelCandidates
methods.description: Generates a list of unique candidate labels for a sender based on their attributes and includes a composite label.
